title: ATP trust-proof revocation response (section 8.1)
description: Structural schema for the section 8.1 revocation response, derived from that section's pinned body with the atp-conformance revocation-list-valid fixture as ground truth for every member except `reason`, whose free text predates the section 8.1.1 codes and which this schema refuses. The body is not signed: authenticity rides on the transport and, for an entry that carries one, its transparencyLogIndex anchoring the revocation in the section 5 log. `transparencyLogIndex` is OPTIONAL: it is the log index of the revocation's own trust_proof_revoked or atx_revoked entry, an authority that logged a trust proof or credential for the agent carries it, and an entry without it revokes an agent the authority logged nothing for. A client applies an entry with or without it and never requires an inclusion proof for an entry without it. Timestamp formats are annotations here; the reference verifiers enforce RFC 3339 parsing and reject the whole response on a malformed timestamp. `reason` is a section 8.1.1 code, never free text: a registered code or a private-use `x-` code. The constraint binds the authority; a client applies an entry whatever its reason and processes a code it does not recognise as `unspecified`.
